architecture-review.json.review: A narrow Process Application query port and explicit selected publication entry reuse existing scoped persistence. Existing source-row FOR SHARE protocol extracted unchanged for legacy guard and selected fence. Effect-owner transaction, Project-before-root ordering, canonical material and complete source comparison, final expiry check; no new project references, entities, schema, cache or lock registry. Registered alias resolves same scoped query. Analyzer's 208 existing diagnostics and blocking-errors flag remain unchanged; direct affected builds pass. New contract remains Process-Agent-specific; inherited business/parent/MAF integration is still closed.
